_readme: DRAFT, not used by the site yet. The preset parameters for the Robotics Scout (see PLAN.md, section 4). Pillar scores (0-5) come from the agent with evidence; the Fit Score, knock-outs and verdict are calculated in code from this file, so changing a weight re-ranks results without new research.
strategy_summary: Aldar deploys robotics across its communities, malls, offices, schools and construction sites in Abu Dhabi and the wider UAE, prioritising proven, safe technology that can be supported locally and operates in GCC heat and dust.

knockouts.label: On a sanctions or restricted list (e.g. US entity list, UAE restrictions)
No working product: only renders or prototypes, no field use
Cannot legally operate, import or be supported in the UAE

pillars.label: Strategic fit
pillars.guide: 0 unrelated · 3 matches a priority use case · 5 matches a priority use case on our asset types with a clear Aldar site in mind

pillars.label: Technology readiness
pillars.guide: 0 concept · 1 prototype · 2 pilot · 3 early commercial · 4 commercial · 5 at scale with uptime data

pillars.label: Proven deployments
pillars.guide: 0 none · 1 one pilot · 3 several paid deployments · 5 many live deployments at comparable sites with named references

pillars.label: GCC readiness
pillars.guide: 0 no regional link · 2 distributor · 3 GCC customers · 4 local office/partner · 5 UAE deployments, heat/dust rated, approvals held

pillars.label: Commercial strength
pillars.guide: funding, backers, revenue signals, headcount trend; 0 distressed · 5 well funded and growing

pillars.label: Integration & safety
pillars.guide: APIs/BMS/FM integration, safety certification (e.g. ISO 13482), cybersecurity, UAE data residency

confidence.high: 3+ independent sources and at least one named customer
